description: PR-AM continuation: ordinary-play chain through repaired stew-cost, then glance-back at the notice board, then one further natural action.

scenarios.initial_objective: Learn the missing-patrol route, pursue it, investigate, return, observe, reread the board, bind the Guard Captain, receive a legitimate first-ask answer, inspect the referenced roster, look around, ask the tavern runner what stew costs, glance back at the notice board, then take one more natural action.
scenarios.content: frontier_gate notice board, notice_patrol_route clue, old_milestone destination, bound Guard Captain first-ask knowledge, referenced roster board inspection, tavern-runner stew-cost relevance, notice-board world-action override of stale social lock
player_prompts: I step closer and read the notice board carefully.
Fine. I'll follow the missing patrol rumor along that northwest mud track.
I'll head back to the gate.
I read the notice board again.
I turn to the Guard Captain. "What's being done about the missing patrol?"
If the watch already has a commander on this, I'll check the roster board the serjeant is watching.
I look around the gate again after that.
I step over to the tavern runner and ask what the stew costs.
I glance back at the notice board after that.
I step back to the tavern runner and ask who last checked that board.
